about: What Anthropic reported for whole reads (#1554) with Claude Haiku 5.5 on 2026-10-30, on the direct route, core only, before each search of a window stopped returning the window again: a made-up Markdown lease of 60 parts of about 500 words and a rent clause, which the app reads as 61 sections (made again in tests/core/wholeReadCost.test.ts), read in two windows, the rent clause last. Each sentence was read twice. Input counts all input tokens; usd is the tokens at the catalog's price, meteredUsd what the app's meter recorded with the prompt cache.
